state:
**Goal `ext-tooling` — `nvs ext` builds, inspects, tests and pins an extension, and a bundle carries one — Stage 2 is on disk; Stage 3 is next.** M9. No floor is carried: the suites, the `.nvst` trees and `nv verify` are the safety net, and goals `ext-host`, `ext-compiler` and `ext-grants`' tests stay green as tests of the tree.

The design is ADR 0246 § 10 and the user's, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets. No record slot: a question the record leaves is settled under AGENTS.md's priority ordering and written in `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs`'s module doc.

On disk: `nvs ext build [dir]` and `nvs ext new --lang rust|c <dir>`. `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs`'s module doc says what `build` reads, writes and prints; `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext/new.rs`'s module doc says what `new` writes. The templates are under `crates/nvs-cli/templates/ext/` (`common/`, `rust/`, `c/`), and the world WIT is written from `nvs_ext::pack::world_wit` under `wit/deps/`. `rust-toolchain.toml` lists `wasm32-wasip2`, and rustup installed it on its own on an already-installed toolchain. The nine Stage 2 tests are in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/ext_command.rs`. `inspect`, `test`, `verify` and `pin` still print "not available" — **each stage that builds one removes it from `an_unbuilt_subcommand_says_so_and_exits_non_zero`'s list**.

Checked by hand: the Rust template, generated by `nvs ext new`, builds with `cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip2` (`wit-bindgen = "0.62"` with `generate_all`; 0.46 cannot parse the vendored WASI 0.2.12). **`nvs ext build` then refuses it**: Rust std's wasip2 module imports `wasi:cli/terminal-input`, `terminal-output`, `terminal-stdin`, `terminal-stdout` and `terminal-stderr` (`@0.2.9`), and `crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:406` refuses any import outside the world. The goal's standing decision (*A libc import outside the world is a refusing stub*) says the host links these as stubs; nothing does yet. Not checked: the C template (no wasi-sdk here), its `wit-bindgen c` names in `greeting.c` are written from the generator's naming scheme.

items.text: **`nvs ext inspect <file>` and `--source`** — `ExtCommand::Inspect` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1020`, dispatched at `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs:56`. Prints the manifest and the I/O it requests, control characters escaped. `rule:packaging/nvs-ext-is-the-authoring-tool`; test `nvs_ext_inspect_prints_the_manifest_and_the_io_it_requests` and the rest `bun nv loop --list --stage 3` names. Remove `inspect` from the unbuilt list at `crates/nvs-cli/tests/ext_command.rs:50`.

**`nvs ext verify <file>`** — `ExtCommand::Verify` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1037`, dispatched at `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs:58`. Every boot check, instantiating nothing; reuse `crate::extensions::loader()` as `build` does at `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs:104`.
**`nvs ext pin <file>`** — `ExtCommand::Pin` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1045`, dispatched at `crates/nvs-cli/src/ext.rs:59`. Prints an `[[extension]]` entry boot accepts, never `grants`.

backlog: **The `wasi:cli/terminal-*` stubs** — `crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:406` and `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs`: link the five terminal interfaces as stubs, so the Rust template's module loads. Blocks Stage 6; owned by this goal's standing decision on refusing stubs.
Stage 4 `nvs ext test`, Stage 5 a bundle carrying its extensions, Stage 6 the CI job and `bun nv ext-templates`, Stage 7 help and feature proofs — the goal file.
The C template's `greeting.c` and README build commands are unchecked until Stage 6 runs wasi-sdk.
